stem:
Priya stands in front of a plane mirror hanging on the wall of her bedroom in Jaipur. She is 1.5 m tall and stands 2.0 m away from the mirror.
Which statement correctly describes the image she sees?

options.text: The image is upright, the same size as Priya, and appears to be 2.0 m behind the mirror.
The image is upright but smaller than Priya, and appears to be 2.0 m behind the mirror.
The image is upside down, the same size as Priya, and can be caught on a screen.
The image is upright, the same size as Priya, and can be obtained on a white sheet of paper.

teacher.key_rationale: A plane mirror always forms an image that is upright (erect), the same size as the object, virtual (cannot be caught on a screen), and as far behind the mirror as the object is in front. Priya is 2.0 m from the mirror, so the image appears 2.0 m behind it. Only option A has all of these properties. B fails on size (image is never smaller), C fails on orientation and screen, D fails because a plane mirror image is virtual.
